rationale: The workflow already implements the applicable, evidence-supported optimizations: P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (Maven ~/.m2, the musl toolchain, and zlib are restored and saved via actions/cache) and P-LIT-FAIL-FAST (matrix strategy.fail-fast: true). No further supported optimization is safe to apply: P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT requires representative successful-duration history, but ci_history reports no_completed_runs / not_a_measured_baseline, and native-image builds on macOS/Windows/Linux are long and variable, so a timeout bound cannot be set without risking valid slow runs (contraindication: valid slow runs exceed the proposed limit). P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE cannot be safety-verified because required_checks status is not_verified with no required-check names confirmed, and canceling superseded or in-progress runs on a potentially required check could affect contract semantics. Bazel, test-selection, and environment-cache patterns do not apply to this Maven/GraalVM native build. Build and test coverage is preserved as-is; no permissions, secrets, publishing/deployment operations, or new network access are added.
